message: The other day, I realized we hadn’t updated our go-bags in a while. Instead of turning it into a chore, I decided to make it a family activity. We gathered in the living room with some snacks, picked out our favorite items to include, and even made a game of it. It felt less like preparing for the unknown and more like a cozy family night in. Have you ever turned a preparedness task into a fun family moment? I’d love to hear your tips!
